introIntent:
EVERY LIFE HOLDS KNOWLEDGE THAT DESERVES
TO BE HEARD, STRUCTURED, AND PASSED ON.
portraitLabel: A visual archive of experience and wisdom
portraitAlt: A monochrome editorial collage of people across generations and fields of practice
pointC: A life carried in gesture and voice
heroTitle:
Human wisdom
does not arrive
as data.
heroDescription:
Preserve the words, images, and EEG records behind a skill.
Keep them together, ready for your team to explore.
heroFormats:
TEXT / IMAGE / EEG EXCEL
SINGLE CHANNEL
intentA: EVERTRACE is a shared archive for a small team. Bring your skill notes, images, and single-channel EEG Excel records together in one place.
intentB: Your original materials stay intact. Organize them by category, explore their waveforms, and download the complete skill pack when you need it.
registerDetail: Create your account and join the shared team archive. No approval step is required.
collectDetail: Write your notes or add text files, then include at least one EEG Excel. Images are optional.
organizeDetail: Choose a shared category or create one. Check your Excel format before saving.
saveDetail: Your skill pack becomes visible to the team after all files upload and pass validation.
exploreDetail: Read, view waveforms, and download the original files or the complete pack.
materialsTitle:
AN EXPERIENCE
LEAVES MORE
THAN WORDS.
materialsDescription: Text and EEG Excel are required. Images add context when you have them.
stillAlt: A monochrome still life of maps, notebooks, tools, and working hands
textNote: Write your notes directly, add non-empty text files, or use both. Your words remain in their original language.
imageNote: Keep JPEG, PNG, and WebP images with your notes. Images are optional and displayed without AI interpretation.
eegNote: Keep each original single-channel Excel and explore its time–value waveform. Every file has its own chart.
signalsDescription: Bring the Excel your device data has been prepared into. View the original single-channel values over time; the archive keeps your original file unchanged.
signalNote: The current template proposal uses timestamp_ms and value. Units and upload limits will be verified against a real device sample before real uploads are opened.
privacyTitle:
YOUR WORK.
YOUR TEAM.
ONE ARCHIVE.
teamRuleText: Registered members can view and download every successfully saved skill pack.
editRuleText: Members create and edit their own packs. Administrators can manage all packs.
originalRuleText: Text, images, and EEG files stay unchanged. V1 displays raw waveforms without filtering or AI analysis.
deleteRuleText: Only administrators can delete entire skill packs. Deletion has no in-app recovery.
studioDescription: Give your skill a title and category. Add its notes and EEG Excel records, with images when useful.
finaleTitle:
ONE LIFE.
COUNTLESS FORMS
OF KNOWING.
footerNote:
HUMAN WISDOM, STRUCTURED.
TEXT / IMAGE / EEG EXCEL
